exceptions.reachability: Expo and NotifyKit reach uuid 7 only through the xcode project generator. xcode invokes uuid.v4() without a caller-provided buffer; the affected v3/v5/v6 buffer overloads are not used and are absent from the shipped JavaScript runtime path.
compensatingControls: Native projects are generated only in trusted CI/EAS environments from reviewed repository configuration.
Expo Doctor, native release checks, and the expiring lockfile audit guard every mobile dependency change.
exceptions.resolution: Adopt the first Expo 57-compatible xcode release that depends on uuid 11.1.1 or newer.

exceptions.reachability: The affected esbuild copy is a development-only drizzle-kit loader. This repository never starts esbuild's development server and production packages omit drizzle-kit.
compensatingControls: Database tooling runs only on trusted source in isolated developer or CI environments.
Production installs omit development dependencies and the exception expires after 30 days.
exceptions.resolution: Upgrade when drizzle-kit removes @esbuild-kit or publishes a compatible patched dependency graph.
